manifest.title: Fresno, California · real Landsat / Census snapshot
manifest.sampling: Systematic nearest native-pixel samples. Display tiles show sampling spacing, not the 30 m observation footprint. Means describe selected samples, not full-resolution area means.
manifest.qa: Reject QA_PIXEL bits 0–5 (fill/dilated cloud/cirrus/cloud/shadow/snow), any QA_RADSAT, optical zero DN, thermal zero DN. No gap filling.

formulas.ndvi: (nir08 - red)/(nir08 + red), after scaling; zero denominator -> null
formulas.ndwi: (green - nir08)/(green + nir08), after scaling; zero denominator -> null

manifest.population_method: Full-tract POP100 counts; bbox estimate uses spherical polygon-area fraction and assumes uniform within-tract population. Neither is a direct bbox headcount.
credits: USGS EROS / NASA Landsat 8–9 Collection 2 Level-2. DOI:10.5066/P9OGBGM6
